qaLog.q: What is user_id meant to be?
How deep is the first feature?

Login gates app + moves data to Supabase (source of truth)

qaLog.q: How is table data stored in Postgres?
qaLog.a: Hybrid: JSON blob per (user_id, table_id) now, normalize later

qaLog.q: How does existing local data become cloud data?
qaLog.a: Cloud starts empty, manual import only
Strictly private per user (RLS user_id = auth.uid())
GitHub Pages default domain; anon key committed
RPC deletes data rows, auth kept

qaLog.q: Protect existing localStorage on login switch-on?

claims.claim: App is a single static index.html deployed to GitHub Pages with no backend/build step
Data stored in localStorage per mode (game-stat-pawapuro-json-v1, game-stat-prospi-json-v1), seeded from data/*.json
Export/import of JSON supported; two modes pawapuro/prospi each with hitters/pitchers sheets
